desc:
Fight your way through haunted stages, collect Souls 💀 and become the scariest animatronic of all!

⚔️ CLEAR STAGES – Defeat ghosts, guards and bosses in 30 creepy stages across 2 worlds
🏆 CLAIM TROPHIES – Step on the pad after each stage to get your rewards
🤖 BECOME ANIMATRONICS – Unlock Freddy, Foxy, Chica, Bonnie, Golden Freddy, Springtrap and more, each with its own SPECIAL attack!
💪 TRAIN – Click in the multiplier zones to farm Souls faster
🔄 REBIRTH – Reset to get a permanent boost and unlock new zones
🥚 HATCH PETS – Open eggs and collect plushies that follow you
👾 WORLD BOSS – Team up to take down Purple Guy and earn Boss Tokens
🎁 DAILY REWARDS & QUESTS – Come back every day for free prizes!

🌙 How far can you get before 6 AM? ⏰

👍 Like the game and join the group for FREE rewards!
